subject: Protecting PII – BYO KMS/HSM options, logging & retention (post-demo)
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@paymodo.com>; Dr. Mark Chen <mark.chen@finware.co>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Protecting PII – BYO KMS/HSM options, logging & retention (post-demo)

Hi Elena / Mark —

Thanks again for the demo time earlier. Quick recap + open items so we have alignment on next steps: we want to make sure your security and compliance questions are clearly tracked.

Call highlights (short):
- Data scope: user-entered PII (name, SSN fragments, bank account metadata) will be sent to Redwood for model inference; logs will capture request metadata; you want minimal retention for prompt content.
- Retention ask: PayModo preference = 30 days for content, but legal has asked about up to 7 years for audit copies.
- Logging: need structured access logs, token-level cost traces, and immutable audit trails for security reviews.
- Encryption: in-transit TLS1.2+ (mutual TLS for some endpoints), at-rest AES-256. Primary ask: BYO KMS with HSM-backed keys and ability to demonstrate key custody and rotation.

What Redwood can provide (summary attached): redwood-byo-options-v2.pdf (attachment) — short options matrix:
1) Customer-managed keys (preferred): integrate your cloud KMS (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault) via our private link; keys remain in your KMS, Redwood stores only wrapped DEKs.
2) Dedicated CMK with HSM partitioning: Redwood-managed KMS but with tenant isolation and FIPS-validated HSMs; good when customers need us to manage keys but still want strong separation.
3) Private deployment (on-prem/VPC): full customer control — keys stay entirely inside customer boundary/HSM.

Open questions / asks from your team:
- Preferred KMS vendor (AWS/GCP/Azure) and whether you require external HSM vendor attestation (e.g., FIPS 140-2/3 Level 3).
- Target retention policy (30 days vs. 7 years for backups/legal); which data classes must be retained longer.
- Who should we engage from PayModo's security/infra team for an integration test (SAML, network peering, KMS test account)?

Proposed next step: technical deep-dive with Camila and Soojin to validate integration pattern and produce a short runbook (30–45 min). Can we tentatively schedule the week of Dec 6?

Attachments: [attachment: redwood-byo-options-v2.pdf (PDF, 38KB)]

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[jordan@redwood.com]

Jordan —

Appreciate the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side:
- PayModo’s security team prefers BYOK where possible. Primary KMS is AWS KMS (we also have GCP for a small team).
- For HSM attestation we need FIPS 140-2 Level 3 or equivalent evidence; is that achievable with your dedicated partition option?
- Regarding retention: primary goal is 30 days for operational data; however, legal retained logs (audit copies) may need up to 7 years — can Redwood separate those pathways?

Mark — would you be available for the technical call? Our infra lead is Oleg Petrov (oleg.petrov@paymodo.com) — please include him on the invite.

Thanks,
Elena
Head of Product, PayModo
[elena@paymodo.com]

From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Protecting PII – BYO KMS/HSM options, logging & retention (post-demo)

Hi Elena — quick answers before the TD: we support the vendor stack you mentioned and can outline concrete steps.

Short answers:
- AWS KMS: supported (we integrate via IAM roles + KMS grants + VPC endpoint for the envelope-encryption flow).
- GCP KMS & Azure Key Vault: supported via equivalent customer-managed-key integrations.
- FIPS/HSM: our dedicated partition option uses HSMs that meet FIPS 140-2 standards; we can provide the HSM vendor attestation and SOC2 section summaries. For BYOK with external HSM (customer-maintained), Private deployment is the pattern we recommend.
- Retention separation: yes — operational prompt content retention is configurable per-account (default 30d). Audit/archive pipeline can be configured to copy structured logs to a customer-controlled bucket for the 7yr requirement (we do not retain audit copies unless you opt-in).

Attachments: kms-capability-matrix.csv (short matrix with supported features by vendor)

Prep for the technical deep-dive: please confirm the following before the call so we can prepare test assets:
- KMS vendor (AWS preferred) and a test KMS ARN we can use / or a JIT test account.
- Network preference: PrivateLink/Private Service Connect or standard public endpoints + mTLS?
- Who from PayModo security/infra will join (Jordan + Oleg + Mark are fine).

If helpful I can paste a concise packet of the integration sequence (envelope encryption flow + key wrap) at the start of the call.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Senior Security Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
